entities.summary: Sir Frank Fraser Darling FRSE was an English ecologist, ornithologist, farmer, conservationist and author, who is strongly associated with the highlands and islands of Scotland. He gives his name to the Fraser Darling effect. Frank Fraser Darling was a scientists & inventors from Chesterfield (1903-06-23, Chesterfield–1979-10-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
